# How to avoid invalid quaternions in Jacobian/SE3 matching when Pinocchio FreeFlyer uses random configurations?

> **Current answer:** Do not directly fill FreeFlyer quaternions with independent random numbers. Project members recommend using pinocchio.randomConfiguration(model, lowerLimits, upperLimits) to generate results that satisfy the model's configuration manifold; or explicitly normalize the random quaternions. The original author's approach of using unnormalized quaternions as errors in SE3 was confirmed by maintainers.
